MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it could complement my existing door alarm and work with my Echo devices, provided installation and subscription requirements suit me.",
    "The outlet extender fits the practical needs created by my Echo devices and computer accessories: convenient power and USB charging, if it fits my outlet space."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV devices repeat a need I recently addressed with my Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle; a different model or themed remote cover gives me little reason to buy again.",
    "The earbuds and watch do not address a current need. Buying a gaming bundle does not mean I need gaming earbuds, and using Alexa does not mean I want fitness tracking.",
    "The tablet offers another screen when my recent Echo Show already meets my immediate home-screen interest, while the whole-home camera bundle is a bigger commitment than the doorbell I would try first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Echo purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost anything with Alexa, even when its main purpose is unrelated to what I need.",
    "My recent streaming and gaming purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more streaming devices and gaming accessories, although it already filled the streaming need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs are already covered; the Echo Show stand is a clearer example of adding something useful to equipment I own.",
    "Compatibility matters when it supports a practical new use, such as a doorbell working with my Echo devices, rather than simply sharing Alexa branding.",
    "I would expand home security gradually, checking installation and ongoing requirements before committing to several cameras."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected-home interests but missed the difference between useful additions, recently satisfied needs, and unrelated products that happen to support Alexa."
}
